methods.moneyUnit: stablecoin smallest unit (6 decimals); displayed dollars = raw / 1,000,000
methods.chainNote: market/stats reports the same openTasks on both chains, so it is platform-wide too except paidWorkers (Base 470, Tempo 189) and activeWallets (Base 3567, Tempo 1011). breakdowns, time-series, heatmap and feed are fetched for both chains and are normally identical (both copies of breakdowns are stored in data.json); when live data moves between the two calls they can differ by a task or two, so the page uses the Base copy and labels these panels platform-wide.
methods.statusNote: Status counts come from /api/stats/breakdowns (2,292 tasks, matching the time-series all-time total). The live /api/tasks list returns 2,116 tasks; the 176-task gap sits entirely in open (228 vs 73), claimed (27 vs 10) and worker_selected (2 vs 0) — the list endpoint appears to omit some tasks in those states. The live open count is confirmed twice: the task list returns 4 on Base + 69 on Tempo, and market/stats reports the same openTasks on both chains.
methods.heatmapDayNote: Heatmap rows are numeric day keys 0-6 from the API (no labels); this page labels them Sun-Sat following the JavaScript weekday convention (0 = Sunday).
